motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Crisp button and border state changes; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary action control with >= 48px touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #0f523b; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b3f2d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0f523b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hold-to-Speak Microphone Trigger
components.css: .ds-mic-btn { width: 144px; height: 144px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0f523b; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(15, 82, 59, 0.22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-mic-btn:hover { background: #0b3f2d; }

components.name: Reading Plate
components.html:
How do I prepare ORS?

Mix one packet in 1 litre of clean water.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: #ffffff; color: #141f1a; border: 1px solid #d6d3c9; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; max-width: 68ch; }

narrative.northStar: Warm Voice-First Health Companion — Kola Cream, Leaf Green & Sunrise Amber
narrative.overview: HealthYarn is built for Yorùbá-, Nigerian Pidgin-, and English-speaking adults across Nigeria, with a landing page at / and voice guidance PWA at /app.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Kola Cream & Sand surfaces with crisp Ink contrast
Sunrise Amber voice focus paired with Ink or Forest text
Self-hosted unified Noto Sans woff2 with complete Yorùbá diacritics
Quarantined Alert Red reserved strictly for danger-sign messaging

rules.name: The Alert Red Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Alert Red (#c8322b) never appears as decoration; it appears only on danger-sign messaging and the emergency alert screen.

rules.name: One Amber Focus Rule
rules.body: Sunrise Amber (#f5a623) uses Ink (#1b1f1d) or Forest (#0a3f33) text—never white—and highlights at most one primary voice focus per view.

dos: Do preserve 18px root typography and >= 48px touch targets across every public control.
Do keep consistent strokeWidth=2 SVG icons beside spoken audio buttons for low-literacy users.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide an explicit autoplay mute toggle in the top header.
donts: Don't add eyebrow/kicker text above headings, gradient text, decorative glass blur, or emojis standing in for UI icons.
Don't use Clinical Crimson (#b91c1c) outside urgent Red-Flag alerts or destructive rejection controls in /admin.
